name.ja: 30MS 天海春香 (20th Anniv. YOU AND アイ！)
name.en: 30MS Haruka Amami (20th Anniv. YOU AND Ai!)

description.ja: 「アイドルマスター」より「天海春香」を30MSフォーマットで立体化！20周年記念衣装「ＹＯＵ ＡＮＤ アイ！」と全身のパーツが同梱されているオールインワンアイテム。
description.en: "Haruka Amami " from " THE IDOLM@STER " is made into 3D in 30MS format! An all-in-one item that includes the 20th lap commemorative costume " YOU AND I!" and full body parts.

description.ja: • 髪飾りパーツは20周年記念衣装のデザインとオリジナルデザインの2種類が付属。
description.en: • Two types of hair ornament parts are included: a 20th anniversary costume design and an original design.

description.ja: • 表情パーツはタンポ印刷を施した3種類が付属。口の中の色分けはパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: • Three types of facial expression parts with tampo printing are included. The color coding inside the mouth is reproduced by dividing the parts.

description.ja: • 衣装は髪飾りや襟元など、細部にクリアパーツを採用し、そのまま組み立てるだけでカラフルな色分けや精密なディテールを再現。
description.en: • The costume uses clear parts for details such as hair ornaments and collars, and reproduces colorful color coding and precise details just by assembling.

description.ja: • スカートは模様をプリントしたシートで再現。
description.en: • The skirt is reproduced with a sheet with a pattern printed on it.

description.ja: • 肌パーツや衣装は仕上げの際に金型表面に艶消し処理を施し、柔らかく光を反射する演出がされている。
description.en: • When finishing the skin parts and costumes, a matte treatment is applied to the mold surface to create a soft, light-reflecting effect.

description.ja: • 表情付きハンドパーツに加えマイクが保持できるハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: • In addition to hand parts with facial expressions, hand parts that can hold a microphone are included.

accessories.ja: フェイスパーツ(タンポ印刷)×3種
